ActorTalk: You are special. But... you are not the one I seek.
(The dark shadow in the Mirror disappeared.)
Me...? I am the sum of everything... But if you do not know me, then you are not... the one I seek.
(The dark shadow in the Mirror disappeared.)
The dark shadow in the Mirror said nothing and simply vanished. Maybe it's just your imagination, but the Mirror's surface seems to have grown dimmer.
